description: Sandals of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Sandals of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Sandals - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 12 - Mooncloth x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Sandals of Faith
